name: vfx_sprint_dust
anchor_note: px-edge coords in the frame: the planted boot's toe point. Place the sprite so this point sits on the boot that lands (girl_sprint_lower frames 1 L / 5 R; toe points in her 160 frame: L (91.5, 130), R (68.5, 130), facing S, pivot (80, 80)).
facing: drawn with travel = +y (S), the same facing as every girl sheet; the dust is kicked back toward -y. Rotate the node with her sprint direction at the moment of the plant (as her sprite), then leave it world-fixed (sprint_dust.gd: set_as_top_level).
flip_h: use flip_h (before the rotation) on right-foot plants so the two feet don't stamp the same puff
z_note: draw under the player (z below her sprite): frame 0 and the start of frame 1 sit under her coat, as sprint_dust.gd's own comment expects; frames 1-3 show behind her as she runs on.
playback: one shot per plant, then free the node / hide it; no fade, no scaling (alpha 0/255, shrink in steps is drawn). 440 ms = sprint_dust.gd's longest puff life; frame 1 (160 ms) holds while her body clears the plant at 5.4 u/s.
lighting: a normal lit sprite (albedo): bright colour comes from the lights. At the tutorial ambient only her presence light reaches the dust behind her, so frame 2-3 are faint there (in NEEDS_BETI).
replaces: the circles drawn by Requiem/requiem/player/sprint_dust.gd _draw() (DUST_COLOR (0.61, 0.59, 0.52), 3 translucent puffs per plant); its emit logic (contacts, travel, MAX_PUFFS) can stay
